Guidance & outlook: Revenue from operations for Q1 FY 2027 stood at INR313 crores as compared to INR328 crores in Q1 FY 2026 last year.
As on date, our order book stands at approximately INR3,104 crores, providing strong visibility for future execution.

Having said that, we are very confident that based on the current visibility, the deliveries are expected to normalize progressively and we are confident of converting this order book into revenue over the coming quarters.
Growth & demand: Even though the reported revenue was impacted by execution timing of certain projects, our focus during the quarter remained on strengthening our order book, executing large customer engagements, and positioning the company for long-term growth in high-value technology infrastructure segments.
In addition, our bidding pipeline stood at approximately INR6,650 crores across data center and cloud, networking, workplace solutions, and managed services.
So, they grew at around 170% and if I talk about the revenue growth on year-on-year basis and the profit growth, it was around 80%.
Margins & costs: EBITDA for the quarter increased to INR40 crores, profit after tax stood at approximately INR20 crores, and earnings per share stood at INR15.54.
You had also hinted at that in the last quarter and achieving a 13% operating margin this quarter is quite phenomenal.

Capex & expansion: Q1 FY 2027 was an important quarter for the company marked by strong order inflows, continued margin expansion, and significant strategic wins across private cloud, data center infrastructure, AI-ready infrastructure, and enterprise technology solutions.

Enterprises and institutions are increasingly investing in mission-critical digital infrastructure, creating long-term opportunities for trusted technology partners with strong execution capabilities and deep customer relationships.
So, we definitely expect that the growth momentum which was there will continue there and we are making all efforts to ensure that the product mix suitably helps in the margin expansion also.
Balance sheet & cash: Sir, this I'm only talking about the repayment of lease rental which is mentioned in the financing activity of cash flow statement and last year our basically right to use asset, it jumped up significantly.
So, really if you ask us on this because cash flow is definitely not provided in part of these numbers there, but whatever the amortizations are, they have been provided there with us.
Risks & challenges: The primary reason for this temporary decline is due to the extended delivery lead-times on certain orders due to OEM and supply chain lead-time issues which have deferred execution and revenue recognition during the quarter.
Therefore, we view this as a timing-related impact rather than a weakening in the underlying business environment.
So, as we have you know mentioned this is more of a timing of revenue recognition rather than a slowdown there in demand.
